name: strike-screen-protocol
notes: ADR-0270 preregistered training/validation PROCEDURE for the strike screen. Pure data: the executable study document (run-strike-screen-arms.json) must pin every value here, enforced by children/index_options/tests. Predictability only: proper scores and calibration; nothing about trading. Every number below is fixed BEFORE any outcome of the validation window is read; a change is a new revision of this file with its own identity hash and ADR line.

formulation.row: (symbol, quote_date, expiry) for every listed expiry with 1 <= dte <= max_dte

inputs.context: calendar_dte, sessions_to_expiry, log_calendar_dte, log_sessions_to_expiry, calendar_days_per_session, reference_scale, rv_1, rv_5, rv_22, rv_66, down_rv_5, down_rv_22, up_rv_5, up_rv_22, momentum_5, momentum_22, vl_log_volume_ratio_66, vl_log_volume_ratio, vl_log_dollar_volume, vl_amihud
inputs.chain: this expiry's surface scalars, logit F_Q(z_k) - logit Phi(z_k) at strike_grid_z, contract set tensor

cohort.rule: price panel ∩ Theta complete through 2020 minus alarmed roots
cohort.basis: split-adjusted closes; chain strikes/underlying rescaled per symbol-day to that basis by the converter

development.note: 2016 dropped: 79 of 118 names have no valid quote before 2017-01-03

monitor_band.rule: last cal_n distinct origins of the fit window, labels purged at the band start

holdout.status: SEALED; fit documents carry holdout_start 2024-01-01; opened once for promoted recipes trained through 2023

windows.purge: a label whose settlement >= the next window start is dropped (label_reaches); no row of one window informs another

fold_tables.notes: CDFHyperparameterStudy selects candidates on the warmup fold only (2019 scored origins, inside development) and evaluates on the scored fold (validation 2020-2023); cells and rules are read from the scored fold AFTER selection and recorded in the next revision of this file before any promotion refit or holdout read. Each fold's monitor band is the last cal_n origins of its own train window.

early_stopping.monitor: composite training loss on the monitor band
early_stopping.ceiling_hit: recorded skip, consumed, flagged for the rung audit, never retried

training.capacity: max_parameters = min(100000, 0.25 * fit rows); refusals are results
training.sharing: pooled: one shared head, no per-ticker heads in the screen (per-ticker heads = +9k parameters, tested as one promotion-rung axis)
training.monitor_band_sensitivity: cal_n 74 in the screen; cal_n 126 as a promotion-rung sensitivity (R5 fold 2 best epoch 1 with a 40-origin single-regime band)

verification_before_any_ranking.synthetic_recoverability: simulate z from a known conditional mixture; the stack must recover it (CRPS within tolerance of the oracle)
verification_before_any_ranking.no_information_control: no-information arm (calendar/scale only) must not beat the empirical reference
verification_before_any_ranking.learning_curves: train vs monitor loss per epoch for every fit; 'best epoch 1' = no learning, reported
verification_before_any_ranking.train_and_validation_scores: every score below computed on fit rows AND validation rows; a validation gain without a training gain is a flag
verification_before_any_ranking.overfit_signature: train score improves while monitor/validation worsens after the best epoch
order: strike Brier vs market/empirical/pooled with clustered intervals

local: decision_strike_brier at the row's listed strikes
region_mass vs realized for the 14 regions
scores.reporting: full window with clustered interval, then each validation year and each sub-period; no sub-period selection

cells.strike_regions: 12 inner 0.5-wide z bins plus two tails

ticker_groups.secondary: fit-band liquidity tercile; later per ticker as descriptive only

per_cell: paired differences with symbol- and date-clustered intervals
cells.promising_cell_rule: paired region-Brier improvement vs market_calibrated AND vs the empirical reference with interval excluding zero, support >= 30 events, >= 20 expiries, >= 20 symbols per year, same sign in >= 3 of 4 validation years; Holm within the primary family; never the best cell by score
cells.decision_point: cells of interest and any rule are written to this file's next revision AFTER the validation screen and BEFORE any promotion refit or holdout read

arms.price_plus_chain: price_only + chain scalars + implied CDF vector (+ contract set when the encoder supports it)

arms_and_candidates.screen_fits: 2 arms x 2 encoders x 2 losses = 8 fits on the screen fold
arms_and_candidates.promotion: top 2 recipes + {price_only mlp L1} audit, 4 refits x 3 seeds each
arms_and_candidates.weighting_guard: L3 rejected if global crps > 0.5% relative worse than same-arm L1
arms_and_candidates.eligibility: paired crps skill vs horizon_empirical > 0 on validation
arms_and_candidates.research_basis: docs/research/distribution-modeling/2026-10-18-model-architecture-size-testing.md: encoder is a secondary axis (12 architectures within ±0.2% on price features); chain branch, loss and size carry the screen

pins_to_fill_before_launch: converter outputs (surface, lifecycle, archive, closes, own_iv) manifest sha256
